snippet.title: Station to Station - Official Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Console Release Date Trailer of Station to Station! 
‘Station to Station’ is a minimalist & relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains! 
The game is launching on November 26 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Nintendo Switch 2, with the game available now on PC (Steam). Pre-order now!
